scripts.migrate:notes: wrangler d1 migrations apply lenso-notes-local --config wrangler.notes.jsonc --local
scripts.types: wrangler types worker-greeting.d.ts --include-runtime false && wrangler types worker-notes.d.ts --config wrangler.notes.jsonc --env-interface NotesEnv --include-runtime false
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.notes.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: bun run test:traces && bun run test:notes
scripts.test:traces: bun build src/index.ts --outdir .lenso/workerd --target browser --external 'node:*' --external 'cloudflare:workers' && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/traces-workerd.test.ts
scripts.test:notes: bun build src/notes.ts --outdir .lenso/workerd --target browser --external 'node:*' && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/notes-workerd.test.ts
